description: Percentage of Access to Broadband for Different Types of Connections By Date (December 2019) Community and Economic Development is a dataset listed in Commonwealth of Pennsylvania open data portal (data.pa.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Commonwealth of Pennsylvania. The availability of broadband by type of connection and area type (rural, urban, all types) in the United States (Nationwide) as of December 2019. Coverage: Pennsylvania. The portal files it under the category Innovation Report. Its tags are satellite, broadband, urban, dced, connections. The table has 6 columns. Attribution on the portal: Department of Community and Economic Development. The portal shows 2021-07-06 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-pa-gov-portal.
